lots.title: Provision of Asbestos Surveys Services (Lot 3 of Framework 6278)
lots.description: Draft Terms & Conditions extract for Lot 3 of the 6278 Building Services Framework between the London Borough of Bexley (the Council) and a contractor to be named, relating to the provision of Asbestos Surveys Services in Council Buildings. The Form of Contract (Part 1) recites a contract period of 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2024. The document embeds the Form of Contract, General Terms and Conditions (Part 2) and Special Conditions (Part 3) only; Schedule 1 (Specification), Schedule 2 (Pricing Schedule), Schedule 3 (the Council's Invitation to Tender) and Schedule 4 (the Contractor's Tender) are present solely as heading-only placeholders at the end of the document and carry no substantive scope, KPI, evaluation criteria or pricing content in this extraction. Scope-defining content (including surveyor qualifications, methodology, deliverables, KPIs in Appendix E to the ITT and the Council's environmental policy at Appendix C to the ITT) is referenced throughout the T&Cs but is not embedded in this document.
requirements: Contractor shall supply the Services during the Contract Period in accordance with the Council's requirements as set out in the Specification, the Code of Conduct at Appendix D to the Invitation to Tender, and the provisions of the Contract (Clause B1.1).

Contractor shall at all times comply with the Quality Standards and where applicable maintain accreditation with the relevant Quality Standards authorisation body; where no standard is specified, perform in accordance with the Law and Good Industry Practice (Clause B3.1).

Contractor shall ensure all Staff supplying the Services possess such qualifications, skills and experience as are set out in the Specification and are necessary for the proper supply of the Services (Clause B3.2).

Contractor shall provide all Equipment necessary for the supply of the Services at its own risk, maintain it in a safe, serviceable and clean condition, and replace any item deemed hazardous or non-compliant by the Council (Clauses B2.1–B2.5).

Contractor shall register with the Disclosure and Barring Service and, where required by the Specification, undertake appropriate criminal records checks in respect of relevant Staff and re-check at least every three years (Clause B4.11).

Contractor shall comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and related acts, orders, regulations and codes of practice, including any health and safety requirements referred to in the Specification (Clauses D6.4, D6.7).

Contractor shall ensure any chemicals, solutions, substances or materials used comply with the Specification, with manufacturer instructions, and with any relevant British or European standard; chemicals must have full approval from the Health and Safety Executive or Environment Agency where applicable (Clause D6.2).

Contractor shall perform its obligations with due regard to the Council's environmental policy at Appendix C to the Invitation to Tender and to Central Government environmental policy (conservation of energy, water, wood, paper; reduction of waste; phasing out ozone-depleting substances; minimising greenhouse gas and VOC releases) (Clause D5.1).

Contractor shall act as Processor of Personal Data in accordance with Schedule 1 only; must comply with Data Protection Legislation, implement Protective Measures including pseudonymisation/encryption, and cooperate on any Joint Controller arrangement identified in Schedule 1 (Clauses E1.1–E1.15).

Contractor shall appoint a suitably qualified, competent and experienced Contract Manager fluent in English, empowered to act for the Contractor and continuously available during specified operating hours (Clause B6.1).

Contractor shall meet each Key Performance Indicator set out in Appendix E to the Invitation to Tender; failure beyond the acceptable failures threshold triggers Service Credits under Clause C3A (Clauses F5.1, F5.4).

Contractor shall provide records and Management Reports summarising the KPIs and the matters referred to in the Specification, in the frequency and format set out in the Specification (Clauses F5.3, F7.1, F7.2).
Contractor shall accept electronic invoices from the Council complying with the Public Procurement (Electronic Invoices etc.) Regulations 2019 (2019/624) (Clause C1.4).
Contract Period runs from 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2024, subject to extension under Clause F8 (Form of Contract Recital A; Clause A6/F8).

Variations to the Specification are permitted under Clause F3 provided they do not amount to a material change; pricing impact to be agreed within a reasonable time limit set by the Council (Clauses F3.1–F3.3).

Special Conditions Part 3 (S1 TUPE) require the Contractor to evaluate TUPE applicability, form its own view on transferring employees, indemnify the Council in respect of TUPE claims, and provide disclosable staff details on any re-letting (Clauses S1.1–S1.7).

warnings.message: Schedule 1 (Specification), Schedule 2 (Pricing Schedule), Schedule 3 (the Council's ITT) and Schedule 4 (the Contractor's Tender) appear only as heading-only placeholders at the end of the document with no substantive content. Surveyor qualifications, survey methodology (HSG264 management surveys, refurbishment/demolition surveys), deliverable formats, sampling regimes, UKAS accreditation requirements, KPIs and any asbestos-specific technical standards (e.g. CAR 2012, HSE HSG264, BS EN ISO/IEC 17020/17025, UKATA, BOHS P402/P404) that would normally live in Schedule 1 are not present in this extraction and so have not been captured as structured requirements or standards.
evidence_refs: Line 57 '(d) The Specification appended hereto as Schedule 1' (reference only)
Line 1215 Part 2 F9.2 precedence list '1. Specification' (heading-only reference)

warnings.message: Award / evaluation criteria, KPI table, Service Credits schedule and environmental policy are referenced as 'Appendix E to the Invitation to Tender' (KPIs, Service Credits), 'Appendix D to the Invitation to Tender' (Code of Conduct) and 'Appendix C to the Invitation to Tender' (environmental policy) but the Invitation to Tender and its Appendices are not embedded in this document.

warnings.message: Clause B4.2 reads 'Staff who are fire risk assessors should hold the qualifications set out in paragraph 3.12 of the Specification' — this is stale boilerplate copied from the Lot 1 (Fire Risk Assessments) template and was not retargeted to asbestos surveyor qualifications for Lot 3. The clause does not encode any asbestos-specific qualification such as BOHS P402/P404, UKATA accreditation or UKAS ISO 17020 inspection-body status.
evidence_refs: Clause B4.2 'In particular Staff who are fire risk assessors should hold the qualifications set out in paragraph 3.12 of the Specification'

warnings.message: Recital A states contract period 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2024 whereas the parent notice (6278 Building Services Framework) is a 2026 procurement stage (current date 2026-04-18). The dates are the document template's dates and should be treated as draft/unresolved rather than the real operative period for Lot 3. The document is titled 'Draft T&Cs'.
evidence_refs: Part 1 Form of Contract Recital A 'during the period 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2024'
Document footer 'FM Asbestos Surveys Services T&Cs 6 August 2020'

warnings.message: This document does not contain lot-specific CPV codes. The parent notice carries three CPV descriptors (50700000-2 Repair and maintenance services of building installations; 50750000-7 Lift-maintenance services; 71315000-9 Building services) that span all 11 lots of the framework; none is specifically tied to Lot 3 Asbestos Surveys inside this document. CPV array is therefore left empty to avoid propagating an unsupported lot-level claim; daemon may hydrate from notice-level data if required.
evidence_refs: Part 1 Form of Contract — no CPV block present
Schedule 1 Specification — heading-only placeholder (would normally carry lot-level CPV)

warnings.message: No product_requirement_seeds emitted. The document defines a services contract (Asbestos Surveys) and does not itemise goods, consumables or equipment specifications. The only goods-adjacent mention (Clause B2 Provision and Removal of Equipment and Clause D6.2 on chemicals/materials) treats equipment/materials as contractor-supplied-as-required rather than as identifiable product seeds. Seeds that might derive from surveyor-grade sampling kits, PPE, or analytical equipment would live in Schedule 1, which is not embedded.
evidence_refs: Clause B2.1 'The Contractor shall provide all the Equipment necessary for the supply of the Services'
Clause D6.2 references to chemicals/materials without itemisation

warnings.message: Pre-existing notice_lots row for Lot 3 in state store describes the lot as 'Provision of Asbestos Assessments … anticipated lot value £60k per annum, PSQ Group 1' (2026 commencement). The document's own phrasing is 'ASBESTOS SURVEYS SERVICES' with 2020–2024 dates. The scope is consistent (asbestos surveying/assessment) but the title wording and dates diverge — treated as template-stale rather than contradictory.
